token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

channels.desc: Comma-separated list of channel names or IDs where the file will be shared.

content.desc: File contents via a POST variable. If omitting this parameter, you must provide a `file`.

file.desc: File contents via `multipart/form-data`. If omitting this parameter, you must submit `content`.

initial_comment.desc: The message text introducing the file in specified `channels`.

thread_ts.desc: Provide another message's `ts` value to upload this file as a reply. Never use a reply's `ts` value; use its parent instead.

method_deprecated.desc: `files.upload` is deprecated. Please use modern upload methods. Read https://docs.slack.dev/changelog/2024-04-a-better-way-to-upload-files-is-here-to-stay for more info.

blocked_file_type.desc: Admin has disabled uploading this type of file

channel_not_found.desc: At least one of the values passed for `channels` was invalid.

invalid_channel.desc: One or more channels supplied are invalid

malware_detected.desc: This file may contain a virus or other malware and can't be uploaded to Slack

not_in_channel.desc: Authenticated user is not in the channel.

posting_to_general_channel_denied.desc: An admin has restricted posting to the #general channel.

slack_connect_blocked_file_type.desc: File uploads with certain types are blocked in all Slack Connect communications

slack_connect_clip_sharing_blocked.desc: Admin has disabled Clip sharing in Slack Connect channels

slack_connect_file_upload_sharing_blocke.desc: Admin has disabled File uploads in all Slack Connect communications

invalid_thread_ts.desc: Value passed to thread_ts was invalid

method_deprecated.desc: This API is deprecated. Please refer to https://docs.slack.dev/changelog/2024-04-a-better-way-to-upload-files-is-here-to-stay
